anya: morning sherpa check — quick standup:

what I did: finished canary smoke for v2-routing, deployed to staging (canary @5%).
blocker: seeing a 3–5% tail latency bump on long-context sessions (>8k tokens).
plan today: triage perf, open PR with modest KV-cache tweak, coordinate kernel rollback window if needed. need spec signoff for fallback policy before we widen canary. @devin @maria

devin: can you paste the failing trace or a small log? I can start digging. which harness did you run?

anya: here's the trimmed output from staging run:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] request_id=abc123 tail_latency_p95=120ms p99=420ms p999=1.2s
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] context_tokens=8200 batching=8 model=redwood-v2
```

maria: I'll review the fallback spec today. quick Q — keep canary at 5% or bump to 10% once initial fixes land? leaning 5% until we confirm p99 regressions are gone. @shawn any ops constraints?

shawn: 5% is safer. if we need a kernel rollback, infra needs a 2h maintenance window. created INF ticket: INF-4392 and pinged infra on the channel.

ci-bot: INF ticket created: https://infra.company/INF-4392 — assigned to infra-team.

devin: opening draft PR now with a KV-cache guard and a perf flag: https://git.company/PR/4321 (WIP) — requesting reviewers @maria @anya

anya: added regression test notes to PR and left comments on the spec doc <https://docs.company/specs/v2-fallback|v2 fallback spec> — marked areas needing signoff.

maria: ack — will sign off if PR adds the unit/regression tests and we confirm no rollback needed after small perf tuning. also, suggest pausing the embedding-cache rollout for next 24h to free up nodes.

devin: agree with pausing embedding-cache rollout. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks all — tagging this as priority: blocker -> high. will update thread after triage.
